subject: science
title: Heart, lungs and circulation
canDo: I can explain how my heart and lungs work together to carry oxygen around my body.

subject: science
title: Keeping healthy
canDo: I can explain how food, exercise, sleep and hygiene help to keep my body healthy.

subject: science
title: Life cycle of flowering plants
canDo: I can describe how a flowering plant grows, is pollinated, makes seeds and spreads them.

subject: science
title: Vertebrates and invertebrates
canDo: I can sort animals into vertebrates and invertebrates and name the five vertebrate groups.

subject: science
title: Food chains
canDo: I can build and read food chains using the words producer, consumer, predator and prey.

subject: science
title: Dissolving and solutions
canDo: I can explain what happens when a solid dissolves and how to make it dissolve faster.

subject: science
title: Separating mixtures
canDo: I can choose sieving, filtering, evaporating or a magnet to separate a mixture.

subject: science
title: States of matter and the water cycle
canDo: I can describe changes of state and explain how water moves around the water cycle.

subject: science
title: Gravity, mass and weight
canDo: I can explain that weight is the pull of gravity on a mass and is measured in newtons.

subject: science
title: Friction, air and water resistance
titleId: Gaya gesek, hambatan udara, dan hambatan air
canDo: I can explain how friction, air resistance and water resistance slow moving things down.

subject: science
title: Light and shadows
canDo: I can explain how shadows form and why their size and length change.

subject: science
title: Sound, pitch and loudness
titleId: Bunyi, tinggi rendah nada, dan kuat lemah bunyi
canDo: I can explain that sounds come from vibrations and say how to change pitch and loudness.

subject: science
title: Variables and fair tests
canDo: I can plan a fair test by changing one thing, measuring one thing and keeping the rest the same.

subject: science
title: Adaptations to habitats
canDo: I can explain how plants and animals are adapted to hot, cold, wet and dry places and as predators or prey.

subject: science
title: Parts of a flower
canDo: I can name the parts of a flower, say what they do and know that not all plants make flowers.

subject: science
title: Air, water and pollution
canDo: I can describe the air around Earth, say that natural water is not pure, and explain what pollution is.

subject: science
title: Magnets and magnetic materials
canDo: I can tell a magnet from a magnetic material and explain that magnetic forces act at a distance and vary in strength.

subject: science
title: Gases and the properties of water
canDo: I can use the particle model for solids, liquids and gases, name common gases and describe key properties of water.
